recipe.visualDefinition: A composite image featuring a group of subjects in the foreground against a large, stylized turquoise ocean wave, characterized by bold, overlapping retro typography and a soft-focus, slightly grainy film texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Subjects positioned in the lower left quadrant looking toward the right
Large-scale wave acting as a dynamic, swirling backdrop
Bold display type anchored at the top, interacting with secondary vertical text
Contrast between the warm skin tones and the cool cyan of the water
coreInvariants: A large, cresting wave filling the background
A primary bold, italicized header across the top
A secondary vertical text element with varying font weights
Soft, diffused lighting on the subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are medium-shot, clustered in the bottom-left third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold blue header at the top edge serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top header down the curve of the wave to the subjects' faces, then follows their gaze to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right side of the frame is relatively open, occupied by the wave's crest and secondary text.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Red/Magenta (numerical digit and text accents)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-key brightness with saturated blues and muted, warm mid-tones in the subjects.

letterConstructionRules: Primary header is ultra-bold, italicized, and tightly tracked
Secondary text uses a tall, condensed, hand-drawn or irregular serif style
Numerical elements are large and overlap the primary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' in the header has a low crossbar
The vertical text features elongated stems and varying heights
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between heavy horizontal sans-serif and light vertical condensed serif.

preserve: Italicized slant of the main header
Cyan color for the main header
Vertical orientation of the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and slant of the primary header
Matches the condensed, high-contrast vertical text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key photograph of three men in light-colored summer shirts (one in a fedora) looking toward the right. The background is a massive, stylized turquoise ocean wave with white foam, captured with a soft-focus 1980s film aesthetic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, italicized cyan sans-serif title across the top. Overlap the right side of the title with a large deep red number. Below the number, place a vertical stack of tall, thin, black condensed serif letters.

verificationChecks: Is the primary header cyan and italicized?
Is there a large red numerical element overlapping the text?
Is the secondary text vertically oriented and condensed?
Is the background a large turquoise wave?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Exact brand logos or technical metadata icons

mustAchieve: Dynamic sense of motion from the wave

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure the subjects' faces
Check that the cyan of the text matches the wave's mid-tones
Verify the vertical text is legible despite its condensed nature
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a dynamic nature backdrop with a tight cluster of subjects in the lower-left, topped with heavy italicized display type and a contrasting vertical secondary font.
